h1: The Wood Pattani Hotel — A Timber-Design Boutique That's Warm, Clean and Affordable
intro: If you want a Pattani stay that looks fresh, is well designed and easy on the wallet, The Wood Pattani Hotel is usually the first name that comes up · A 3-star boutique that opened in 2022 with 64 rooms, dressed in warm timber tones throughout, sitting on Charoenpradit Road in the city centre near cafes and the shopping area · Guests keep mentioning the clean rooms, strong hot showers and attentive staff · Rooms start from around ฿1,100/night

Interior detail at The Wood Pattani Hotel highlighting woodwork and warm lighting
General atmosphere of The Wood Pattani Hotel in central Pattani

body.html: The Wood Pattani opened its doors in 2022, making it one of the newest hotels in town · The name says it all — the whole building leans into woodwork, from the lobby and corridors to the furniture in each room · Many reviews note that walking in feels more like stepping into a cafe than a business hotel, and the timber detailing paired with warm lighting makes photos come out nicer than you'd expect at this price.

Across the 64 rooms there are several types, from Standard and Deluxe to Deluxe Corner and Premier · The praise that comes up again and again is that rooms are clean and the hot showers run strong — exactly the things travellers worry about at small provincial hotels · Beds are soft, the wooden furniture looks good and the lighting is gentle rather than glaring · The Deluxe Corner is a guest favourite for its extra space and additional windows.
"Beautiful, clean room with a really strong hot shower, lovely timber detailing that photographs well, attentive staff and easy parking — for this price in Pattani it's great value."

Location is another point in The Wood's favour · Sitting on Charoenpradit Road in the city centre, it's close to cafes, restaurants and the shopping area, with several spots a short walk or drive away · Some staff speak the local Malay dialect, which puts both regional guests and Muslim travellers at ease · Parking is available and convenient, though a few reviews mention the entrance is a touch narrow and needs a careful turn.

One thing to know before you book: The Wood is a simple hotel with no swimming pool and no full breakfast service on site · It focuses on clean, well-designed rooms and a good location · For coffee or a morning meal, there are cafes and eateries within walking distance, which actually suits Pattani, a city where the best food lives in local shops rather than hotel buffets.

The complaints in reviews are minor · Some guests note the bathroom has no wet/dry zone separation, so water can splash across the floor while you shower · A few rooms cool down a little slowly on very hot days · And being a small city-centre property, the common areas aren't as expansive as bigger suburban hotels · Even so, most guests give high marks and say they'd stay again.

With a 9.0 out of 10 on Trip.com (162 reviews) and steady praise for cleanliness and design, The Wood Pattani Hotel is a sensible pick for anyone wanting a fresh boutique with attractive rooms in the city centre, in the ฿1,100–฿1,500/night range · If you don't need a pool or a breakfast buffet but care about clean rooms and good atmosphere, this is one of the best-value stays in Pattani.

honestSummary: The Wood Pattani Hotel is a new boutique that delivers clean rooms, good design and a central location at a friendly price — ideal for travellers who value the room and atmosphere over a full list of facilities · The trade-off is no pool and no on-site breakfast, but cafes and eateries sit within walking distance.
honestChecks: If you want a pool or a breakfast buffet at the hotel — The Wood has neither, it's rooms only → choose a larger hotel with a pool and restaurant instead
If you're sensitive about a fully wet bathroom floor — the bathroom has no wet/dry separation, water splashes easily → be prepared or ask for extra towels
If you want a fresh, clean, well-located stay that doesn't cost much — handsome timber design, walkable to cafes, easy parking → this is the best fit in the ฿1,100–฿1,500 range

faq.q: Where is The Wood Pattani Hotel and what's nearby?
faq.a: The Wood Pattani Hotel is at 17/10 Moo 6, Charoenpradit Road, Soi 10, Rusamilae, Mueang Pattani · It sits in the city centre near cafes and the shopping area, walkable to several spots · Prince of Songkla University (Pattani campus) is about 5 minutes by car, and Pattani Old Town about 10 minutes.

faq.q: How much does The Wood Pattani cost and what room types are there?
faq.a: Rooms start from around ฿1,100/night · Types range from Standard, Deluxe and Deluxe Corner (corner units) up to Premier at about ฿1,600 · Prices vary by date and platform, so compare a few sites before booking.

faq.q: Does The Wood Pattani have a swimming pool and breakfast?
faq.a: There is no swimming pool and no full breakfast service. The hotel focuses on clean, well-designed rooms · It has parking, an elevator and 24-hour reception · There are cafes and eateries within walking distance for breakfast.

faq.q: Who is The Wood Pattani best for?
faq.a: It suits travellers who want a fresh boutique with clean, well-designed rooms and a central location at a friendly price · It prioritises the room and atmosphere over a long facilities list · If you need a pool or breakfast buffet, consider a larger hotel.

faq.q: How new is The Wood Pattani?
faq.a: The Wood Pattani opened in 2022, making it one of the newest hotels in town · Rooms and finishes still feel new, with warm timber design throughout · It scores 9.0 out of 10 on Trip.com from 162 reviews.
